tool_input.new_string:
<view v-for="(a, i) in studyArticles" :key="'l' + i" class="article-card study-article" role="button" @click="openArticle(a, true)">
        <view class="article-main">
          <text class="article-title">{{ a.title }}</text>
          <view class="article-foot">
            <text v-if="a.tag" class="article-tag" :class="tagClass(a.tag)">{{ a.tag }}</text>
            <view v-if="a.meta" class="article-meta">
              <view v-if="a.meta.includes('分钟')" class="article-clock-icon" aria-hidden="true"></view>
              <text class="article-meta-text">{{ displayMeta(a.meta) }}</text>
            </view>
            <view v-if="a.trailing" class="article-trailing">
              <view v-if="a.trailing.includes('次学习')" class="article-eye-icon" aria-hidden="true"></view>
              <text>{{ a.trailing }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view v-if="a.image" class="article-image-wrap" role="button" @click.stop="previewArticleImage(a.image)">
          <image class="article-image" :src="a.image" mode="aspectFill" />
          <view v-if="a.detailType === 'video'" class="article-play-button" aria-hidden="true">▶</view>
        </view>
      </view>
